chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Bob Carroll and the musicians from Louisville and the Midwest
summary: Bob Carroll, Dickie Wells, Frankie Newton, Bill Coleman, Jonah Jones and Buddy Lee came out of Louisville; Ohio, Indiana and Illinois had many territory bands.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, let's see, there was a great deal of -- What about --
Jonah Jones. -- What about the saxophone player, big, tall saxophone player named -- let's
see if I can recall his name here. He --
Was he with -- Who was he with?
He had perfect pitch and he played saxophone. A very tall guy, a very rough man. He used to get into a lot of trouble fighting.

Bob Carroll, he was from Louisville, like a lot of good musicians came out of Louisville. Dickie Wells came out of Louisville. I think Frankie Newton came out of Louisville. I think Bill Coleman, too.
And Jonah Jones and Buddy Lee. They all came out of Louisville. There's a lot of good musicians around that territory.

That whole territory, Ohio, Indiana, Illinois. A lot of good musicians came from that territory. They used to have territory bands out there, you see, in Ohio. I can name you five territory bands out of Ohio that was working all the time.
That's where these guys came from, you see.
